resources.string: Lets you say \"Audora, pause\", \"play\", \"next\", \"back\", \"repeat\", \"faster\" or \"slower\" with the reader open. Everything is heard on your phone; nothing is recorded or sent. Needs %1$d MB.
While the reader is on screen, Audora listens for \"Audora\" and a command, and Android shows the microphone indicator. Uses a little battery while it listens.
Download the voice commands model first.
Keep listening with the screen off

While a book is open in the reader, Audora also listens with the screen off or in another app, and shows a notification you can stop it from. Stops 10 minutes after reading is paused in the background. Uses more battery.
Voice commands need the microphone. You can allow it in Android\'s app settings.
